paraphrase.proposes: The track gives the track scope of the mid-red gate to the spec-review and ux-browser-review gates, the ux-paths command, and the jr-green HEAD check. Each scoped check reads only the files of the track and prints the skipped commits as INFO lines. The spec-review gate runs the tree diff first in each mode and fails closed when the tree is unreadable. The change adds ux_relevant, the ux-paths --track option, the contracts text, and the install.
paraphrase.current_system: The spec-review gate lists the tree diff and the per-commit history, then fails when a committed file is outside measure/runs/. The ux-browser-review gate fails when ux_paths finds a UX file and PROJECT_DEV_URL is unset. The jr-green gate HEAD check passes when any commit moves HEAD. The ux-paths command prints the UX paths of the whole range and has no --track option. The mid-red gate already scopes by track id through red_scope and commit_paths.

nonblocking_findings: F8 [Nit] spec.md Decisions D4: the sentence "The checks of `--baseline` run first and do not change" does not name the reference point of "first", and the result-file check runs before the baseline checks in the current code. Rationale: the implementer must guess whether to move the result-file check; with a failing result and an unresolvable baseline the messages would print in a different order, and no acceptance criterion pins that order.
